judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a definition of done (`.lore/dod.md`), a spec update (`specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`), and failing acceptance tests (`src/orchestration/usageAcrossRounds.acceptance.test.ts`), without ever touching the implementation in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` still overwrites `lastUsage` instead of accumulating across rounds, the candidate's own new tests will fail and the bug remains unfixed. Furthermore, it missed updating the hook signature (`totalUsage?: UsageMetadata`), `CHANGELOG.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`. While the acceptance tests and spec change are well-aligned with the ticket's requirements, the missing implementation makes the PR broken and incomplete.
